{{Top|leg}}
Having the '''jeeblies''' was a slang term that [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] used to describe a feeling of fear that came with the anticipation with an individual's first battle. Commanding [[Officer/Legends|officers]] were aware of this and did everything possible to prevent a recruit from freezing up on the battlefield.
